marker_rule: Unique contiguous normal1..10 or autostop1..11 train; each ID once; width2*ID+0.24us +/-0.80us at native0.5us grid; normal lifecycle plus3<11<8.
onset_definition: First >=20mA native sample in500ms before receiver marker; preceding1ms finite with absolute mean<100uA.
plateau_definition: First whole1ms bin after marker10 with10 consecutive bin means6..12mA;1ms endpoint resolution.
qualification: Post5ms window finite/contiguous, native power integrated; first5ms and whole-cycle integrals remain provisional. Markers establish firmware observations, not independent image integrity or Standby flags. Auto-stop frame count and autonomous FSM2 must be qualified from retained AST/sensor/STROBE evidence; the receiver snapshot and one phase2 marker cannot count all sensor exposures.
limits: Input-side JS voltage, not target voltage after sense/wire drops.
Final packed GPIO chunk excluded; all remaining unmatched edges preserved.
Normal flash cycles include camera, card and populated Nucleo support loads.
Card initialization, slot scan and write latency can vary; report each run and interval rather than attributing every time change to PHY power-down.
Native extrema are retained but not qualified physical peaks.
standby_marker_qualification: Normal cold firmware has no sensor STOP marker. Do not substitute frame IRQ or infer an exact normal STOP tail from this waveform.
cold_scope: Cold start from measured current onset through low-current plateau. All currents include the full powered board. Marker10 plus low current does not independently prove fresh SBF, a particular saved slot or image integrity.
